description.en: Compare two versions of an image with a divider that bends as you drag and glides to the edge when flicked.
description.zh: 拖动分隔线对比两张图。线条随手势弯曲，快甩时滑到边缘。

keywords: 弹性 图片 对比 黑白 彩色 滑块 果冻 拖动 分隔线 Bencho image compare before after slider drag

discovery.caveat: 自定义前后图需保持相同构图和比例。默认使用同一张画的彩色和灰度状态。

source.implementation: MIT-licensed Bencho Image compare source adapted to the native LeiBox lifecycle with scoped design tokens and six framework entries.
source.license: MIT code, Copyright (c) 2026 Lorenzo Cabra. The free block license is at https://bencho.dev/licence. The demonstration artwork is generated for this adaptation.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Drag the divider to compare the images. Flick toward either edge, or use the arrow keys, Home and End.
instructions.zh: 拖动分隔线对比图片，快速甩动可滑到边缘。也支持方向键、Home 和 End。
